prompt:
Research what the Home Assistant project has officially published about the number of active installations (its opt-in analytics). Cite the page and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the web search results, the Home Assistant project has published two distinct sets of figures regarding active installations and analytics. The analytics platform page provides the current real-time count of active installations sharing data, while the 2025 State of the Open Home blog post provides an official milestone for total estimated active installations in 2024.

SOURCE: https://analytics.home-assistant.io/ | QUOTE: "695,026 Active Home Assistant Installations" | CLAIM: As of the data snapshot, there are 695,026 active Home Assistant installations reporting to the analytics system.
SOURCE: https://analytics.home-assistant.io/statistics/ | QUOTE: "496,813 of 637,194 (77.97%) installations have chosen to share usage statistics" | CLAIM: Out of 637,194 installations, 496,813 (77.97%) have opted in to share their usage statistics.
SOURCE: https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2025/04/16/state-of-the-open-home-recap/ | QUOTE: "One big announcement Franck made was that this year we went from 1 million to over 2 million active installations in 2024!" | CLAIM: The official number of total active Home Assistant installations grew to over 2 million in 2024.
